mods.name: Ocean Expansion
mods.description: A Village Friends add-on that makes the sea worth exploring: ten rare sites. A lighthouse and its keeper, a Tidewatch sea fort, a smugglers' rock, a sunken treasure galleon, a whale fall, a drowned temple of the Old Tide, a pearl grotto, a diving bell with an air pocket, a ship frozen in an iceberg and the ember vents of the deep, with pearls, giant clams, sea glass, a storm glass and a diving helmet.
